title: A Failure Mode Taxonomy and Severity Model for Ethereum Smart Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2610.41685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smart contracts are a core component of blockchain systems, but their immutability makes failures in deployed code catastrophic and irreversible. Existing work classifies vulnerabilities, defects, and attacks, yet the observable failures of smart contracts, the deviations from intended behavior or the expected ledger state seen once a contract is deployed, have been largely disregarded. In this paper, we design and validate a failure mode taxonomy for Ethereum smart contracts, together with a severity model that ranks failures by their observable impact. Using a literature review as input, we follow the taxonomy development method of Nickerson et al. to derive the failure modes and their dimensions, and we subject the resulting taxonomy to a saturation exercise over a systematic literature review, the OpenSCV vulnerability catalog, and smart contract incidents reported after the search cutoff. Each failure mode is characterized along fiv

translated_title: 以太坊智能合约的失效模式分类法与严重性模型
translated_abstract: 智能合约是区块链系统的核心组件，但其不可更改性使得已部署代码中的失效是灾难性且不可逆转的。现有工作对漏洞、缺陷和攻击进行了分类，然而智能合约的可观察失效——即合约部署后所观察到的与预期行为或预期账本状态的偏差——在很大程度上被忽视了。在本文中，我们设计并验证了一个针对以太坊智能合约的失效模式分类法，以及一个根据可观察影响对失效进行排序的严重性模型。我们以文献综述作为输入，遵循 Nickerson 等人的分类法开发方法来推导失效模式及其维度，并通过基于系统性文献综述、OpenSCV 漏洞目录以及搜索截止日期之后报告的智能合约事件的饱和度检验，对所得到的分类法进行验证。每个失效模式沿五个维度进行特征刻画（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文设计并验证了首个针对以太坊智能合约的失效模式分类法和严重性模型，填补了现有研究只关注漏洞、缺陷与攻击而忽视合约部署后可观察失效行为的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper designs and validates a failure mode taxonomy and a severity model for Ethereum smart contracts, filling the gap left by existing work that focuses on vulnerabilities, defects, and attacks while largely disregarding the observable failures of deployed contracts.
